source: nflverse/nflfastR-data models/dakota_model.Rdata (mgcv gam: target ~ s(cpoe) + s(epa_per_play)), tabulated with mgcv 1.9.1 predict.gam(type="terms") on 2026-10-27
inputs: epa_per_play: mean of qb_epa floored at -4.5 over pass and rush plays with a down, posteam and passer or rusher id; cpoe: mean cpoe over those plays, 0 when none
interpolation: linear in each term; max error 3.7e-7 against predict.gam on 14,578 passer-weeks
